violation_type.title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs - Free Standing Climbing (26 TAC §746.4605(a)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Equipment Prohibited for Younger Than 5 Yrs - Free Standing Climbing
violation_type.typical_finding: Children under the age of five were allowed to use a prohibited piece of playground equipment.

finding_variants.text: Children under the age of five were allowed to use a prohibited piece of playground equipment.
The Geometric dome climber must be removed as it is located in an area accessible to children younger than 5 years of age.

At the time of the inspection one large playground area had 2 structures. One structure had a rope web that children could climb on, but no clear separation of the structures for the younger and older age groups. The structure with the flexible web rope climbing piece would be accessible to children under 5 years of age.
Children under the age of 5 were seen using a 3-tier self-standing climbing structure that was not approved by childcare regulations, in an area that has not been licensed.
A geometric dome climber was observed on the playground that is designated for all ages of the children enrolled.
